company.name: Binocs
company.shortDescription: GenAI platform that automates deal research & due diligence for private equity and strategy consulting teams
company.description:
Binocs is an agentic AI platform that automates deal research and strategic advisory for private equity funds, consulting firms, investment banks, and corporate development teams. Its AI agents mimic the structure of real-world investment teams to generate decision-ready outputs — including commercial due diligence reports, investment memos, industry primers, deal screening summaries, growth strategies, sell-side CIMs, credit assessment memos, and financial statement analysis — at a fraction of the time and cost of traditional approaches.
Trusted by 2 of the top 60 PE funds in the US and 2 of the Big 4 consulting firms, Binocs delivers consistent, citation-backed outputs with enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 compliant). Its platform covers the full deal lifecycle — from origination and screening to diligence, portfolio value creation, and exit preparation.
Backed by Accel, Blume Ventures, Beenext, Arkam Ventures, and Premji Invest. Recognized by CIO Tech Outlook as one of the top 10 most promising GenAI startups of 2025 and selected for the NASSCOM GenAI Foundry and INSEAD AI Venture Lab.
